scenes.narration: Three hundred points, five centers. Each step, every point picks its nearest center, and the centers move. There is no loop over the points.

sentences.text: Each step, every point picks its nearest center, and the centers move.

scenes.narration: First, the distance from every point to every center. One expression gives the whole table, a row for each point, a column for each center.

scenes.narration: Then the smallest number in each row marks the nearest center. One reduce finds it for every point, as rows of zeros and ones.

scenes.narration: Turn that table on its side and multiply by the points. That adds up each group. Divide by the counts, and you have the new centers.

scenes.narration: Now repeat the step. From a poor start, three centers crowd one blob and get stuck. From a far apart start, each center finds its own blob.
